Em.SeedBirdNestDescription: A small house-like bird feeder for wild birds; every few days they may leave you something in return as long as it is filled with snacks.
Em.BirdNest2: Hello @,^Have you noticed less seeds around the trees? This is because of the returning wild birds who enjoy picking out the seeds from between the branches. If you put out a snack or some nesting material, they might leave you something in return. I've attached the instructions on how to build a bird feeder for them.^- Marnie
